note: MIN-C prospecting (Mining spec stage 2 and section 4; docs/build17/MIN_C_PROSPECTING.md), read by Prospecting (game/scripts/core/prospecting.gd). Clues are stains on the ground, placed from the world seed by integer hashing over blocks of the village (never world.rng, never the overworld's chunks): a clue marks a search area of `radius` cells round its stain, not a deposit. Some clues lie over a mineral body (`true_percent`), the rest mislead. A body is geology only (ore and grade, and the cell it lies under): it is never a deposit record; opening it is MIN-D's. Samples are rock chips taken with a prospector's kit inside a clue's area, a finite number per clue (`samples_per_clue`), one per cell; an assay (a smith at a forge, with fuel) reads one sample with uncertainty and never with certainty. Every number here is an agent decision (minor detail under the standing release directive), not owner-approved balance.

iron_ore.stain: a rust-red stain in the soil

gold_ore.stain: a glitter of flecks in the gravel
